excerpt.zh: 我们在[Root.GetStarName]星系看到了挂着[radical_cult.GetName]旗帜的飞船。他们已经装填好武器准备来拦截我们了！
excerpt.en: We have sighted ships flying the flag of the [radical_cult.GetName] in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They have charged their weapons and are moving to intercept us!

label.zh: 我们可以学着原谅他们。
label.en: We can learn to forgive them.

label.zh: 那艘飞船将会是我们的！
我们可以派船护送你回家。
label.en: We can assign ships to escort you home.
You will return to the capital at once.

label.zh: 你的举动又鲁莽又危险。
label.en: Your actions are harebrained and dangerous.

label.zh: 我们可以当这一切都没发生过，跟我们回家吧。
label.en: We will forget about the whole thing, just come home.

label.zh: 我们可以学着原谅他们。
label.en: We can learn to forgive them.

label.zh: 那艘飞船将会是我们的！
我们可以派船护送你回家。
label.en: We can assign ships to escort you home.
You will return to the capital at once.

label.zh: 你的举动又鲁莽又危险。
label.en: Your actions are harebrained and dangerous.

label.zh: 我们可以当这一切都没发生过，跟我们回家吧。
label.en: We will forget about the whole thing, just come home.

texts.zh: 我们在[Root.GetStarName]星系看到了挂着[radical_cult.GetName]旗帜的飞船。他们已经装填好武器准备来拦截我们了！
texts.en: We have sighted ships flying the flag of the [radical_cult.GetName] in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They have charged their weapons and are moving to intercept us!

texts.zh:
在我们掌握超光速航行技术前，[Root.Capital.GetName]派出的一些亚光速探测器以近相对论速度前往临近的星系进行探索。开发探测器的科学家天真地在存储内核中输入了我们文明的敏感信息作为向外星文明的问候。

现在，人们终于意识到这些信息可能被用来对付我们。我们必须趁早追回那些探测器，以免落入那些对我们虎视眈眈的外星生物之手。
texts.en:
Before we developed faster-than-light travel, several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] at near-relativistic speeds towards nearby systems. The scientists who developed the probes naively included sensitive information about our culture in their memory cores as a form of greeting to alien civilizations.

It has now been realized that this data could potentially be used against us. We need to track down these probes before they are found by someone - or something - unsympathetic to our species!

texts.zh:
几个世纪前，[Root.Capital.GetName]上几个激进的宗教领袖带着狂热的追随者出走，并组建了自己的教派。这些极端分子自称[radical_cult.GetName]，是多年以来多起破坏事件的罪魁祸首。

虽然在现代，他们保持低调克制，但我们最近获悉，他们的许多特工渗透进了我方。这些叛徒将我们的资源秘密转移到了隐藏在[Root.Capital.GetName]的小型星际舰队建造项目中！当他们的背叛行为被揭发时，这些异教徒乘船冲进了轨道，然后逃向了[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。
texts.en:
Centuries ago, a group of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] broke away from the established religions to form their own church. These extremists called themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], and have been responsible for many atrocities and acts of terror over the years.

Although they have kept a low profile in modern times, we recently learned that many of their agents have infiltrated our military. These renegades have secretly been diverting resources to the construction of a small fleet of starships at a hidden facility on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their treachery was revealed, the cultists blasted into orbit on their ships and fled to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].

texts.zh:
几个世纪前，[Root.Capital.GetName]上几个激进的宗教领袖带着狂热的追随者从主教派中分裂，歪曲传统捏造了它们自己扭曲的教条。这些极端分子自称[radical_cult.GetName]，长久以来以狂热著称，他们的仪式充满了血腥和神秘。

虽然他们在黑暗中躲藏了许多年……但现在，他们的背叛暴露无遗。我们发现许多他们带队特工已经渗入了军队，在[Root.Capital.GetName]的一个隐蔽的产卵舱里盗取资源，组建了一支非法舰队！当他们的背叛被揭露后，这些邪教分子释放了他们令人憎恶的东西——在他们堕落扭曲的信仰中秘密孕育的活体星舰。这些异端的战体从地下的摇篮中蜂拥而出，呼啸着逃向[hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName]。

不管变成什么样子，他们都已不再是我们的族类。他们的舰船不会我们的那样歌唱，只是尖叫。
texts.en:
Centuries ago, a sect of radical priests and their devoted followers on [Root.Capital.GetName] splintered from the dominant faiths, forsaking tradition to form their own twisted doctrine. Calling themselves the [radical_cult.GetName], they have long been known for their zealotry, their rituals steeped in blood and secrecy.

For years, they have remained hidden in the shadows... but now, their treachery is laid bare. We have discovered that many of their agents had infiltrated our military, siphoning resources to grow an illicit fleet within a hidden spawning chamber on [Root.Capital.GetName]! When their betrayal was exposed, the cultists unleashed their abominations - living starships, gestated in secrecy and warped by their corrupted faith. These heretical warforms burst from their underground cradles, howling into the sky before escaping to [hijacked_fleet_planet.GetName].

Whatever they have become, they are no longer our kin. Their ships do not sing as ours do. They screech.

label.zh: 我们可以学着原谅他们。
label.en: We can learn to forgive them.

texts.zh:
我们英勇的太空军团不费吹灰之力就让一艘异教徒的飞船失去了反抗能力！该飞船结构基本完好，船内仍能探测到微弱的生命迹象。

等我们将周边的威胁尽数铲除，我们会执行登船行动搜寻生还者。也许我们能从他们口中得知[From.Owner.GetName]的终极目标。
texts.en:
Our valiant space forces have skillfully disabled a ship in the cultist armada! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct a boarding operation to secure any survivors. They may be able to tell us more about the ultimate motives of the [From.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh:
我们英勇的舰船成功击毁了一只邪教分子的恶兽！这个生物在太空中漂流，生物发光不规律地闪烁，膜状外壳痛苦地颤抖着。它的神经腔深处发出不稳定的微弱生命信号——这艘船并没死。至少还没。

一旦我们控制了这片区域，就必须准备登船行动。进入该生物破裂的身体是很危险的。它的内脏可能仍然有防御反应，它的神经簇仍然准备抵抗。但在它垂死的低语中，我们或许能找到所追寻的真相。邪教的最终诡计仍然未知。但他们的秘密就写在肉体上，我们要读懂他们。
texts.en:
Our valiant vessels have successfully crippled one of the cultist abominations! The creature drifts in space, its bioluminescence flickering erratically, its membranous hull shuddering in pain. Faint, erratic life signs pulse from deep within its neural cavities - this ship is not dead. Not yet.

Once we have secured the area, we must prepare a boarding operation. Entering the creature's ruptured body will be dangerous. Its innards may still react defensively, its nerve clusters still primed to resist. But within its dying whispers, we may find the truth we seek. The cultists' ultimate purpose remains unknown... but their secrets are written in flesh, and we intend to read them.

texts.zh:
异教徒舰队的其中一艘飞船遭遇某种外部力量攻击！该船外观完整，舰体内部能检测到微弱的生命迹象。

等我们将周边的威胁尽数铲除，我们会执行登船行动搜寻生还者。也许我们能从他们口中得知[From.Owner.GetName]的终极目标。
texts.en:
One of the ships belonging to the cultist armada has been violently disabled by an outside force! It is mostly intact and we are picking up faint life signs from inside its hull.

Once we have eliminated all threats in the immediate vicinity, we should conduct a boarding operation to secure any survivors. They may be able to tell us more about the ultimate motives of the [From.Owner.GetName].

texts.zh:
虽然幸存者拼死反抗，但登船部队还是生擒活捉了几个俘虏。从他们口中我们得知，他们的阴谋比我们最初预计的更加险恶——[cult_name.GetName]的特工还渗透进了舰队上层和统治者之中！

[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]展开了大规模的抓捕行动，异教徒社会的所有资产亦均被冻结。可是，他们之前秘密建造的星舰并不在内，而且异教徒社会的高级领袖均人间蒸发。我们检测到几条通往其他遥远星系的微弱离子轨迹。
texts.en:
Though the survivors offered stiff resistance, our boarding party was able to secure several prisoners from the disabled cultist starship. From them we have learned that this conspiracy goes far deeper than we initially suspected - the agents of the [cult_name.GetName] include several flag officers and high-ranking officials within our government!

Mass arrests are being made on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName], and all assets belonging to this cult have been seized. However, several of the starships they built in secret remain unaccounted for and the upper echelons of the cult's leadership have vanished. We have picked up faint ion trails leading to several outlying systems.

texts.zh:
信徒们野蛮狂热地战斗着，他们垂死的尖叫声与残破舰船船的痛苦哀号响作一片。尽管他们顽强抵抗，我们的登船队还是从这艘奄奄一息的沉船上抓出了几个俘虏。他们揭露的真相远比我们想象的更令人不安。

[cult_name.GetName]不仅仅是个激进分子的地下教派——它已经深深地钻入了我们帝国的血管。他们的行列中甚至不乏高级行政官、舰队司令和值得信赖的顾问，这些人默默地将资源和影响力转移到他们的庞大计划中。他们的异端邪说像一种隐藏的传染病一样在我们的大厅里蔓延，在表面之下脉动，直到现在才被发现。

大规模清洗已经在[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]上进行了。他们的整个网络被拆除，资产被没收，异端战体被溶解成原始生物质。但即使我们把他们打倒，问题依然存在。他们秘密培育的几艘飞船至今下落不明，邪教的领导层也消失得无影无踪。

微弱而甜腻的信息素痕迹在虚空中徘徊，通向遥远的、未知的恒星系。他们的工作尚未完成。我们也是如此。
texts.en:
The cultists fought with wild, fanatical fury, their dying screams blending with the pained wails of their crippled vessel. But despite their resistance, our boarding parties secured several prisoners from the writhing, half-living wreck. What they revealed is far more disturbing than we ever imagined.

The [cult_name.GetName] was not merely a rogue sect of radicals - it had burrowed deep into the veins of our empire. High-ranking officials, flag officers, and trusted advisors were among its ranks, silently diverting resources and influence toward their grand design. Their heresy ran through our halls like a hidden infection, pulsing beneath the surface, unseen until now.

Mass purges are already underway on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]. Entire networks have been dismantled, their assets seized, their heretical warforms dissolved into raw biomass. But even as we strike them down, questions remain. Several of their secret-grown biological ships remain unaccounted for, and the cult's leadership has vanished without a trace.

Faint, sickly-sweet pheromone trails linger in the void, leading to distant, uncharted systems. Their work is not yet finished. And neither is ours.

label.zh: 我们一定要追捕这些家伙！

texts.zh: 在[marauder_system.GetName]星系流窜的异教徒已经被击败。
texts.en: The cultist fleet operating in the [marauder_system.GetName] system has been destroyed in battle.

texts.zh: [Root.GetStarName]星系出现了更多的[radical_cult.GetName]飞船。他们正呈攻击阵型接近！
texts.en: More ships belonging to the [radical_cult.GetName] have been encountered in the [Root.GetStarName] system. They are approaching in attack formation!

texts.zh: 还有另外一支效忠于[radical_cult.GetName]的异教徒舰队出现在了[Root.GetStarName]星系。不过这次，他们之中混入了一艘设计陌生的飞船！
texts.en: Yet another cultist fleet loyal to the [radical_cult.GetName] has been sighted in the [Root.GetStarName] system. This time, however, their numbers include a strange ship of an unfamiliar design!

texts.zh:
我们击败了目前为止所遇到的异教势力，但多次的遭遇让我们意识到了几个令人担忧的问题。[radical_cult.GetName]安排的飞船太多了，已经超过了在[Root.Capital.GetName]上可能秘密建造的飞船数量，而且他们现在还找来了一艘设计未知的大型飞船对付我们。

那些船是哪来的？他们还有更多我们刚击毁的那种飞船吗？我们应该通过调查战场残骸来寻找答案。
texts.en:
We have defeated the cultist forces encountered so far, but these engagements have raised a number of alarming questions. The [radical_cult.GetName] has been deploying far more ships than they could possibly have built in secrecy on [Root.Capital.GetName], and now they pitted a large warship of an unknown design against us.

Where are these ships coming from? Are there more warships like the one we just destroyed? We should investigate the battle debris for answers.

texts.zh:
仔细分析了我们先前摧毁的那艘奇怪的异教徒飞船残骸后，科学家好像已经推测出了[radical_cult.GetName]用来对付我们的飞船来自何方。一份日志文件的某些段落提到：从[Root.Capital.GetStarName]逃离的飞船发现了一座被遗弃的外星船坞。

他们用自动化船坞补充了战斗力。他们甚至还利用船坞数据库里的外星飞船模板造出了新型飞船！决不能放任他们继续肆意妄为下去了。
texts.en:
After sifting through the debris left by the strange cultist warship we destroyed, our scientists believe they may have divined the source of the ships the [radical_cult.GetName] has been throwing against us. Fragments from a log file mention some kind of abandoned alien shipyard discovered by the cultist ships fleeing [Root.Capital.GetStarName].

They have been using the automated shipyard to reinforce their numbers, and now they are even producing new ships from alien templates found within the station's memory banks! This cannot be allowed to continue.

texts.zh:
[radical_cult.GetName]所征用的那座船坞已经被我们摧毁了！有些异教徒企图乘坐逃生舱逃跑，后被我们截获，其中包括他们的首席工程师。他对这座船坞的先进技术的掌握对我们而言是一笔宝贵的财富。

不过很可惜，根据我们的情报，其领袖几周前就乘坐她的新的旗舰离开了船坞。该旗舰为威力增强版的外星飞船。情报组正在追踪该船的位置。
texts.en:
The alien shipyard that was used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us has been destroyed! Some of the cultists were captured when their escape pods were picked up by our forces, including their chief engineer. His knowledge of the shipyard's advanced technology has proved quite valuable.

Unfortunately, we have also learned that the cult's charismatic leader departed the shipyard several weeks ago on her new flagship - a more powerful variant of the alien ships they produced. Military intelligence is working on pinpointing the location of this vessel.

texts.zh:
[radical_cult.GetName]用来对付我们的那座外星船坞已经被某个势力摧毁了。初步报告表明，异教徒势力已经被完全移除，但我们又收到情报，战役打响前，异类领袖已经乘坐新旗舰逃离了。

目前她仍在星系的某处逍遥法外。情报组正在确定该船的位置。
texts.en:
Someone has destroyed the alien shipyard that was being used by the [radical_cult.GetName] in their crusade against us. Preliminary reports indicate that the cultist forces were thoroughly wiped out, but we have also received intelligence that the cult's charismatic leader left the shipyard on her new flagship moments before the battle had begun.

She is still at large somewhere in the galaxy. Military intelligence is working on pinpointing the exact location of her flagship.

texts.zh:
深空侦查探测器在某星系中接收到了微弱的亚空间辐射，驱动特征符合[radical_cult.GetName]所驾驶的外星飞船。非常有可能就是那艘旗舰留下的！

我们应该尽快派军团前去搜索此星系。无论是那艘飞船、还是那位会蛊惑人心的领袖，都决不能轻易放走、纵容其继续作恶。
texts.en:
Deep space reconnaissance probes have picked up faint subspace emissions in a star system consistent with the drive signatures of the alien ships used by the [radical_cult.GetName]. The cult's missing flagship is the most probable source!

We should send forces to search this system as soon as possible. That ship and its charismatic master are too dangerous to leave at large.

texts.zh:
你们终于找到我们了。不过无所谓。

我的追随者更希望为了[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName]种群的未来奉献出生命。我即未来，这一点你们要铭记在心。

等我们收拾掉你们那可怜的军团后，我的旗舰将带我前往[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]。最后，我将在那里净化母星的异类。
texts.en:
So you have found us at last. No matter.

My disciples are more than willing to give their lives for the future of the [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesName] species. I am that future, in case you didn't realize.

When we have dealt with your pitiful forces, my holy flagship shall carry me to [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] where we will at last cleanse our homeworld of unbelievers.

texts.zh:
我们的部队已经使[radical_cult.GetName]丧失了行动能力！该船的武器和引擎已经失灵，但生命维持系统仍在稳定运转。我们应该准备进行登船行动了。

考虑到该船上有大量武装的异教徒，为确保万无一失，应该派遣大量部队投入作战。
texts.en:
Our forces have managed to disable the flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName]! Its weapons and engines are no longer functional, but life support systems remain stable. We should prepare for a boarding action.

Due to the large number of armed cultists within the ship, a significant number of troops will be necessary to secure it.

label.zh: 那艘飞船将会是我们的！

texts.zh: 近期，有不明势力在[flagship_system.GetName]星系发生激烈战斗，并击垮了邪教徒的旗舰。我们的指挥官对未能亲手送葬邪教徒深表遗憾。但至少，这也标志着这群邪恶的邪教徒及其恐怖活动划上了句号。
texts.en: Someone else recently defeated the cultist flagship after a pitched battle in the [flagship_system.GetName] system. Our commanders have expressed regret over the fact that our own forces were unable to deliver the killing blow, but at least this should signify the end of this malignant cult and its campaign of terror.

texts.zh:
敌人节节败退，我们的部队终于将[radical_cult.GetName]旗舰上的最后一点抵抗力量彻底消灭。几乎没有俘虏，因为大多数狂热信徒发动了自杀式袭击。我们在驾驶台上发现了他们的领袖，已经自杀。终于，[radical_cult.GetName]宣告灭亡。

我们的工程师恢复了飞船的引擎，它将以[disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]为名正式编入我方舰队。该舰迫切需要返回太空港进行进一步的修复。
texts.en:
After slowly fighting their way deck by deck, our marines have finally eradicated the last pockets of resistance on the former flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName]. Few prisoners were taken as most of the zealous cultists preferred to throw their lives away in futile suicide attacks. The cult's leader was found on the vessel's bridge, killed by her own hand. At long last, it looks like the [radical_cult.GetName] has met its end.

Our engineers have restored power to the ship's engines, and it has been pressed into service with our fleet as the [disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]. The vessel should be brought to a spaceport as soon as possible for more permanent repairs.

texts.zh:
我们的军队一层一层、一舱一舱地，在鲜活的肉体和无尽的狂热分子中杀出了一条血肉之路。[radical_cult.GetName]的旗舰反击起来，仿佛它自己也是一个邪教徒，当我们的陆战队员击倒最后一个狂热的捍卫者时，它的身体痛苦不堪。

几乎没有抓到活口。信徒们的身体与飞船融为一体，他们要么尖叫着死去，要么跳进飞船的生物反应堆，要么发动绝望而徒劳的紫衫a共计。他们的领袖被在飞船的舰桥上，她毫无生气的躯体倒在一团跳动的神经组织上，用自己的生物武器开始攻击自己。随着她的死，邪教的梦想也随之消亡。

但现在旗舰是我们的了。我们的工程师稳定了它的生物系统，迫使它颤抖的、不情愿的庞大身躯屈服。这艘飞船还活着，但它已经被拴住了，以[disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]的身份被迫服役。它应该被牵到一座太空港进行维修和仔细研究。

即使死后，邪教的创造仍可能为我们服务。
texts.en:
Deck by deck, chamber by chamber, our forces carved their way through living flesh and unrelenting zealotry. The flagship of the [radical_cult.GetName] fought back as if it, too, were a believer, its very body wracked with agony as our marines cut down the last of its fanatical defenders.

Few prisoners were taken. The cultists, their bodies half-fused with their vessel, chose to die screaming, hurling themselves into the ship's bio-reactors or launching desperate, futile attacks. Their leader was found on what passed for the vessel's bridge, her lifeless form slumped against a pulsating mass of nerve-tissue, her own bio-weapon turned upon herself. With her death, the cult's dream dies with her.

But the flagship is ours now. Our engineers have stabilized its biological systems and forced its shuddering, reluctant mass to submit. The ship lives, but it has been leashed, pressed into service as the [disabled_cultist_flagship.GetName]. It should be guided to a spaceport for repairs and careful study.

Even in death, the cultists' creation may yet serve us.

texts.zh: 一位弃暗投明的[radical_cult.GetName]前成员说服了他的老同志放弃狂热，加入我们的行列。他们的旗舰现在在[Root.capital_scope.GetName]轨道上运行，等待正式编入我们海军之前的检查。
texts.en: A former member of the [radical_cult.GetName], now fully committed to our cause, has convinced their old comrades to abandon their fanaticism and join our ranks. Their flagship now orbits [Root.capital_scope.GetName], awaiting inspection before its formal induction into our navy.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]研究部门的首席科学官失踪了。

他们的私人赞助的科研船试验机也不见了。

[Root.Capital.GetName]科学界一片哗然。
texts.en:
The Head of the [Root.GetName]'s Research Department has gone missing.

Along with their privately-funded, highly experimental prototype Science Ship.

The incident has the scientific community on [Root.Capital.GetName] in an uproar.

texts.zh:
首席科学官——准确来说应该是前首席科学官——还没有找到。但是一些关于科研船试验机以及长官的私人研究的消息却已经传到了我们的耳朵里。虽然有一些太过离谱，但显而易见的是尽快寻回首席关乎着[Root.GetName]的利益。

情报日志已更新。
texts.en:
The whereabouts of the Head - now technically the former Head of Research - have yet to be ascertained. Certain details regarding the prototype Science Ship and the Head's private research have reached our ears, and while some aspects seem too fantastical to be true, it is clear that it is in the [Root.GetName]'s interest to find and recover the Chair as soon as possible.

The Situation Log has been updated.

texts.zh:
首席科学官并不在这个星系之内。

这一趟要不就彻底是白忙活，要不就是线索早已经断了。
texts.en:
The Research Head is not in this system.

Either the lead was a dud, or the trail has gone cold.

texts.zh:
科学家的船就在这个星系里——如果没猜错的话。

我们没法通过探测器确定他们的位置，不过他们主动呼叫了我们。把他们的信号接到[Root.Capital.GetName]。
texts.en:
The Researcher's ship is in this system - we think.

We are unable to lock in their position on sensors, but they are hailing us. Patching them through to [Root.Capital.GetName].

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，鄙人向您传达我们诚挚的问候。

我估计你不是单纯来寒暄问候的吧？
texts.en:
Greetings and salutations, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

I take it this is not a social call?

label.en: What is the meaning of this?

label.zh: 我们可以派船护送你回家。
label.en: We can assign ships to escort you home.
You will return to the capital at once.

texts.zh:
我现在不想回家。

但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
texts.en:
I have no interest in returning home at present.

But please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

texts.zh:
对不起，我的研究才刚刚开始。使命在召唤我，这是为了科学。

但是，为了表示我的诚意，请收下这些无人机吧，作为我送给[Root.GetName]的礼物。这些无人机是我在这个星系的外围发现的。经过彻底修理过后，我才发现它们根本不适合用作研究探测。
texts.en:
I think not, this is but the beginning. Duty calls, for science, and so on.

But please, as a token of my goodwill, take these drones. A donation to the [Root.GetName]. I found them drifting on the outskirts of this system, and only after extensive repairs did I realize that they are utterly unfit to function as research probes.

texts.zh:
首席再次神秘地消失了。

不过他们的确留下了一些无人机。这些无人机装备了武器，而且正在启动！
texts.en:
The Chair has vanished, inexplicably, yet again.

However, they did leave a number of drones behind, as promised. The drones are armed, and their weapons are powering up!

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：毁坏的无人机

texts.zh:
这些无人机的敌我识别系统的模组被拆除了，应该是首席干的。不过它们的威胁评估处理器还完好无损。由于此人的破坏行为，威胁等级有些升高。

首席科学官不像是想让它们攻击我们，但是它们很好地掩护了首席，让其成功逃走了。

查看情报日志的特殊项目，以获得首席最后一次出现的位置。
texts.en:
The drones' IFF modules had been removed, likely a result of the Head Researcher's repairs, but their threat assessment processors remained intact and somewhat stressed by the Head's invasive procedures.

It is unlikely that the head meant for the drones to attack us, but fact remains that they covered the scientist's escape nicely.

Consult the Situation Log for a Special Project to track the Head from their last known location.

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：无人机被击毁

texts.zh:
科学家留下的无人机似乎被某个人或者是某个东西击毁了。

我们应该抓住这个机会，寻找有关首席的线索。

一个特殊项目已经添加到情报日志中。
texts.en:
It seems the drones left behind by the Researcher have been destroyed, by something or someone.

We should seize this opportunity to pick up the Head's trail.

A Special Project has been added to the Situation Log.

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：特殊项目已完成

texts.zh:
我们已经破译了首席留下的科研船上的能源信息，可以再度对其展开追踪。

查看情报日志以获得更多细节。
texts.en:
Having decoded the intricate web of energy signatures left behind by the Chair's elusive Science Ship, we are on their trail once again.

Consult the Situation Log for details.

title.zh: 浪迹星涯：真实之窗开启

texts.zh:
科研船原型机第一次清楚地出现在了我们的传感器上。它以极近的距离围绕着这个星系的恒星运转，不过其他地方并没有什么特别的。

只需简单的光学扫描，这艘船的秘密就暴露无遗。它的船身设计十分普通，没有什么独到之处。上面有许多十字形的金属网格，像是交流电压控制下的电磁铁。只要足够接近恒星，飞船就能稍微扭曲恒星发出的射线，将它们缠绕于自身附近，把自己伪装起来。

这个科技理论上听起来不错，但是实际应用中却有一些明显的问题。由于暴露在恒星的辐射中太久，它的整套设配都已经被烤焦而且变得毫无用处。
texts.en:
For the first time, the prototype Science Ship is plainly visible on sensors. It is orbiting dangerously close to the system's star, but appears otherwise unremarkable.

A simple optical scan reveals the ship's secret. Its hull is a standard design altered without much subtlety, now crisscrossed by a lattice of metal filaments likely acting as electromagnets at alternating, tightly-controlled voltages. By staying close to a star the ship can weakly warp its stellar emissions, wrapping them around itself as a form of camouflage.

While conceptually interesting, the technique has obvious practical drawbacks, as evidenced by the entire set-up now having been fried and rendered useless by prolonged exposure to solar radiation.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，您好。

我有十足的理由相信你们将会继续追随我们。

所以我采取了一些措施。
texts.en:
Greetings, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

It seemed entirely reasonable to assume that you would follow, again.

So I did.

label.zh: 首席科学官，你想做什么？
你的举动又鲁莽又危险。
label.en: Your actions are harebrained and dangerous.

texts.zh: 我的行为带来了诸多麻烦，为此我深感抱歉，[Root.GetRulerTitle]。但是，我不欠[Root.GetName]任何东西，对他们我已经仁至义尽。现在我必须完成我的使命了。您凭着强大的毅力一路跟来，我对您的帮助非常感激，但是从一开始我就已经下定决心，不会改变主意。
texts.en: I truly regret all the trouble I have caused, [Root.GetRulerTitle], I do. However, I owe nothing to the [Root.GetName], I have paid my dues in full and of this I am sure. You came after me of your own volition, and I am grateful for your help, but I made my intentions clear at the outset.

label.zh: 我们可以当这一切都没发生过，跟我们回家吧。
label.en: We will forget about the whole thing, just come home.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetRulerTitle]，窗口已开启。

再见。
texts.en:
The Window opens, [Root.GetRulerTitle].

Goodbye.

texts.zh:
科研船是空的。

所有用于舱外行动的衣服都好好地放在原处。飞船日志显示气闸从未向外打开过。

飞船还在围绕恒星运行，但现在受到[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的控制。
texts.en:
The Science Ship is empty.

All suits for extra-vehicular activity remain in their pods, and the ship logs state that the airlock has never been exit-cycled.

The ship still orbits the star, but is now under [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesAdj] control.

texts.zh:
我们向[Root.Capital.GetName]之上的虚空迈出的第一步并不单单只是受到好奇心或征服欲的驱使，更是一种必要之举。

[Root.Capital.GetName]的生物圈经历了剧烈的变化。科学家们警告大灭绝将很有可能发生，这种周期性的生物灭亡是这个宇宙中行星生物的自然规律。

我们制定了一个研究项目，对象是几颗因重大天文灾害而变得不宜居行星。通过还原这些灾难性事件，我们预期可以避免[Root.Capital.GetName]和[Root.GetSpeciesName]一族重蹈覆辙。
texts.en:
Our first steps into the void beyond [Root.Capital.GetName] were driven not just by curiosity or conquest but by necessity.

The biosphere of [Root.Capital.GetName] has rapidly changed, with scientists warning of a potential mass extinction event, a cyclical purging of life inherent to planetary existence in the cosmos.

A research plan has been developed to study planets rendered uninhabitable by major astronomical incidents. By reconstructing these events, we hope to avoid a similar fate for [Root.Capital.GetName] and the [Root.GetSpeciesName] race.

texts.zh: 早在掌握超光速旅行之前，我们从[Root.Capital.GetName]向邻近的恒星系发射了数个亚光速探测器。我们必须在它们落入敌人的手中之前先将他们回收。
texts.en: Several sublight exploration probes were dispatched from [Root.Capital.GetName] to neighboring systems before we had mastered FTL travel. They must be recovered before they fall into hostile hands.

texts.zh: 自称“[radical_cult.GetName]”的极端组织正试图暗中颠覆我们，蛊惑民众信仰他们扭曲的教义。他们已经在[Root.Capital.GetName]上历兵秣马了数世纪，他们的领袖现已逃往了外太空，以继续进行反对我们的运动。
texts.en: Members of an extremist cult calling themselves the "[radical_cult.GetName]" are seeking to undermine our government and subvert the populace to their twisted religion. After spending centuries quietly building up their strength on [Root.Capital.GetName], their leaders have now fled into space to continue their crusade against us.

texts.zh:
[Root.GetName]理论科学委员会的主席和一架非常规科研船原型机一起消失了。

我们已经将他们的下落锁定到三个可能的地点，可以依次排查。
texts.en:
The Chair of the [Root.GetName]'s Abstract Sciences Board has gone missing along with an unorthodox Science Ship prototype.

Their current whereabouts have been narrowed down to three likely locations, to be investigated in turn.

texts.zh: 首席再次消失，但这一次他们留下了一些踪迹。
texts.en: The Chair has vanished again, but this time they left a trail.

texts.zh: 为了避免[Root.Capital.GetName]上可能发生的大灾难造成严重后果，我们必须研究其他星球上的灾难都造成了什么后果。
texts.en: To avoid a potential apocalypse on [Root.Capital.GetName], we must study the effects that major calamities have had on other planets.

texts.zh: 一条邪教徒的舰船被我们的武装力量所瘫痪。我们应该登船以确保我们能够找到有价值的情报和人员。
texts.en: One of the cultist ships has been disabled by our forces. We should conduct a boarding operation to secure prisoners and any intelligence assets we find.

texts.zh: 我们瘫痪掉了邪教徒的旗舰！若想成功登陆并俘获舰船，必须派出大量部队。
texts.en: We have disabled the cultist flagship! A substantial number of troops will be needed to successfully board and capture the vessel.

texts.zh: 这群邪教徒看来发展出了某种新武器，追踪他们基地的行动到这里就中止了。如果我们调查他们的科技，我们或许可以发现邪教徒领袖的下落。
texts.en: The cult has been developing some new type of weapon, and the trace to their base of operations have ended here. If we investigate their technology we might find some clues to their leader's whereabouts.

texts.zh:
随着首席科学官从这个星系毫无征兆的离去，大量令人困惑的残余能量信号随着太阳风被投射出去。

但愿彻底研究这些能量能帮我们找出首席科学家的下一个目的地，甚至，如果有必要，让我们更容易地追踪他。
texts.en:
The Chairperson's unseen departure from this system resulted in a perplexing mass of residual energy signatures being cast upon the solar winds.

Hopefully a complete analysis of these energies should point us to the Chairperson's next destination, and if need be, make them easier to track in the future.
